landing.heroTitle: Learn languages by really talking to people
landing.heroSubtitle: Dilva pairs you with native speakers so you can chat, get corrected, and learn together — in Kurdish (Badini), Turkish, English and more.
landing.mockMessage1: How do you say "good morning" in Badini?
landing.mockMessage2: Beyanî baş 🌅 — I can correct your posts too!
landing.howItWorksTitle: Three steps to your first real conversation
landing.step1Desc: Pick a username, your native language, and the language you're learning.
landing.step2Desc: Our matching engine finds people who speak what you're learning — and want to learn what you speak.
landing.step3Desc: Message in real time, post in your target language, and get corrected by natives.
landing.feature1Desc: A smart matching engine pairs you with people whose native language is what you're learning — and vice versa.
landing.feature2Desc: Post in the language you're learning and native speakers can correct it right there, sentence by sentence.
landing.feature3Desc: Real-time messaging with a translate button for whenever you get stuck.
landing.feature4Title: See who's nearby, and who visited
landing.feature4Desc: Dilva Premium unlocks a live map of learners near you, and shows exactly who checked out your profile.
landing.ctaSubtitle: It's free to start — pick your languages and say hello.
landing.footerTagline: Language exchange & social learning, in Kurdish (Badini), Turkish and English.

install.androidDesc: One tap adds Dilva to your Home Screen as a real app — no Play Store needed.
install.androidFallbackStep1: Tap the ⋮ menu in the top right of your browser.
install.androidFallbackStep2: Choose "Add to Home screen" or "Install app".
install.iosDesc: Three quick steps and Dilva becomes a real app on your Home Screen.
install.iosStep1: Tap the Share button at the bottom of the screen (square with an arrow up).
install.iosStep2: Scroll down and choose "Add to Home Screen".
install.iosStep3: Tap "Add" in the top right — Dilva now appears on your Home Screen.
install.desktopTitle: Open this link on your phone
install.desktopDesc: Installing only works on a phone (iPhone or Android). Copy this link and send it to your phone.
install.alreadyInstalledDesc: You already have the Dilva app on this device — just open it.
